title: GraphQL connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One GraphQL instance's settings, read by the native protocols family (`loams_connector_protocols::graphql`, CN2 Task 21): queries and mutations over the SDK's egress-checked HTTP client, subscriptions over `graphql-transport-ws` (R21.2). A source is a `query` or a `subscription`, not both. `auth.*` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`.

auth.description: A bearer token or a key in a header, by secret name.

bearer.description: A bearer token (`oauth2`). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

secret.description: The key. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

prefix.description: Text before the key in the header value.

query.description: A Relay-cursor query source (batch, resumable): one `item` event per node.
The query; it takes the page-size and cursor variables.

connection.description: The Relay connection in the answer, a JSON pointer (`/data/viewer/repositories`).

poll_interval_ms.description: Restart from the first page after this long; read once without it.

subscription.description: A subscription source over `graphql-transport-ws` (streaming, not resumable).

url.description: `ws://` or `wss://`; the HTTP URL with its scheme swapped when omitted.

mutation.description: The sink: one mutation per event.

variables_pointer.description: Where the variables object is in the event's data (a JSON pointer); the whole data when omitted.
